content: Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API https://historical-forecast-api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast is HRRR-model-based (1-5km res), data from ~2021-2022 present, matches live forecast format -- best for bias-correction/consistency with live inference. Archive API (ERA5, 1940-present, 10km) recommended instead for Phase 7's deep historical backfill need.
